observations.description: FortiGate does not load balance requests evenly when the ldb-method is set to least-session.
Session dropped with timeout action after policy changes.
Inaccurate sFlow interface data reported to PRTG after upgrading to 7.0.
Source interface filter (srcintf-filter) is not working with virtual servers.
FortiLink NAC matched device is displayed in the CLI but not in the GUI under WiFi & Switch Controller > NAC Policies > View Matched Devices.
Unable to access GUI via HA management interface of secondary unit.
HA failovers occur due to the kernel hanging on FG-100F.
The HA pair primary keeps sending fgFmTrapIfChange and fnTrapIpChange after upgrading to 7.0.6.
Session load balancing is not working in HA A-A configuration for traffic flowing via the VLAN interface when the port1 link is down on platforms with a 4.19 kernel.
After changing the password policy to enable it, all non-conforming IPsec tunnels were wiped out after rebooting/upgrading.
Unable to edit the parent interface from the IPsec configuration if it was configured on an IPIP tunnel.
Unexpected dynamic selectors block traffic when set mesh-selector-type subnet is configured.
Unable to reestablish a new IPsec L2TP connection for 10 minutes after the previous one disconnected. The issue conditions are local in traffic and a policy-based IPsec tunnel.
Improper IKEv1 quick mode fragmentation from third-party client can cause an IKE crash.
WAD crash at signal 11 is observed after configuring 250 CGN VDOMs (full offload is enabled in the VDOMs).
WAD daemon runs high with many child processes and is not coming down after configuring 250 CGN VDOMs.
IPv6 route redistribution metric value is not taking effect.
The speed-test-server list cannot be loaded due to limited buffer size.
IPv6 SD-WAN health check is not working after a disconnection.
FortiGate as an NTP server is not using SD-WAN rules.
Upgrading from 6.4.8 to 7.0.5 causes SDN firewall address configurations to be lost.
Only the first ACI SDN connector can be kept after upgrading from 6.4.8 if multiple ACI SDN connectors are configured.
Updated empty group with SAML user does not trigger an SSL VPN firewall policy refresh, which causes the SAML user detection to not be successful in later usage.
sslvpnd crashes when no certificate is specified.
SSL VPN daemon sometimes could not be recovered, even when setting the server certificate back from empty to a specific certificate.
SSL VPN web mode bookmark incorrectly applies a URL redirect.
SSL VPN crashes after copying a string to the remote server using the clipboard in RDP web mode when using RDP security.
The sslvpn process crashes if a POST request with a body greater than 2 GB is received.

Browser displays an Error, Feature is not available message if a file larger than 1 MB is uploaded from FTP or SMB using a web bookmark, even though the file is uploaded successfully. There are no issues with downloading files.
Get newcli crash when running the diagnose hardware test memory command.
As the size of the internet service database expands, ffdb_err_msg_print: ret=-4, Error: kernel error is observed frequently on 32-bit CPU platforms, such as the FG-100E.
HQIP memory test failed and triggered a log out with a newcli process crash.
IPS and application control is causing the FortiGate (VWP) to change either the source MAC address or the destination MAC address based on the flow.
Outbandwidth does not control traffic properly on platforms with a 4.19 kernel when VDOM links are used.
FG-3700D unexpectedly reboots after the COMLog reported a kernel panic due to an IPv6 failure to set up the master session for the expectation session under some conditions.
DHCP relay does not work properly with two DHCP relay servers configured.
There may be a race condition between the CMDB initializing and the customer language file loading, which causes the customer language file to be removed after upgrading.
SFTP backup not working with Azure storage account.

The WAF is indicating malformed request false positives caused by incorrect setups of four known headers: Access-Control-Max-Age, Access-Control-Allow-Headers, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, and Origin.
System events logs randomly contain a msg=UrlBwl-black gzopen fail message.
Unrated is displayed, even if the system language is set to Japanese when the policy inspection mode is set to flow.
The cw_acd process is deleting dynamic IPsec tunnels on the secondary device, which causes the FortiAPs to disconnect on the primary device.
The new HA primary FortiGate cannot get EMS Cloud information when HA switches over.
observations.workaround: delete the EMS Cloud entry then add it back.

observations.description: When there are many users authenticated by an explicit proxy policy, the Firewall Users widget can take a long time to load. This issue does not impact explicit proxy functionality.
FG-3000D cluster kernel panic occurs when upgrading from 7.0.5 to 7.0.6 and later.
Increased CPU usage in softirq after upgrading from 7.0.5 to 7.0.6.
Standard and full ISDB sizes are not configurable on FG-101F.

On the System > FortiGuard page, the override FortiGuard server for AntiVirus & IPS Updates shows an Unknown status, even if the server is working correctly. This is a display issue only; the override feature is working properly.

On the Network > Interfaces page when VDOM mode is enabled, the Global view incorrectly shows the status of IPsec tunnel interfaces from non-management VDOMs as up. The VDOM view shows the correct status.
On the Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy page, the policy list can take around 30 seconds or more to load when there is a large number (over 20 thousand) of policies.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to configure policies.

observations.description: System > Certificates list sometimes shows an incorrect reference count for a certificate, and incorrectly allows a user to delete a referenced certificate. The deletion will fail even though a success message is shown. Users should be able to delete the certificate after all references are removed.
When using the SSL VPN web portal in the Firefox, users cannot paste text into the SSH terminal emulator.
observations.workaround: use Chrome, Edge, or Safari as the browser.

observations.description: When upgrade firmware from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2, the GUI incorrectly displays a warning saying this is not a valid upgrade path.
An undefined error is displayed when changing an administrator password for the first time. Affected models: NP7 platforms.
When viewing entries in the slide-out window of the Policy & Objects > Internet Service Database page, users cannot scroll down to the end if there are over 100000 entries.
On the Network > Routing Objects page, editing a prefix list with a large number of rule entries fails with an error notification that The integer value is not within valid range.
observations.workaround: edit a prefix list with a large number of rule entries in the CLI.

observations.description: When private data encryption is enabled, all passwords present in the configuration fail to load and may cause HA failures.

After packets go through host interface TX/RX queues, some packet buffers can still hold references to a VDOM when the host queues are idle. This causes a VDOM delete error with unregister_vf. If more packets go through the same host queues for other VDOMs, the issue should resolve by itself because those buffers holding the VDOM reference can be pushed and get freed and recycled.
FortiGate 4200F, 4201F, 4400F, and 4401F HA1, HA2, AUX1, and AUX2 interfaces cannot be added to an LAG.

Sessions being processed by hyperscale firewall policies with hardware logging may be dropped when dynamically changing the log-processor setting from hardware to host for the hardware log sever added to the hyperscale firewall policy. To avoid dropping sessions, change the log-processor setting during quiet periods.
Hit count not ticking for implicit deny policy for hardware session in case of NAT46 and NAT64 traffic.
service-negate does not work as expected in a hyperscale deny policy.
srcaddr-negate and dstaddr-negate are not working properly for IPv6 traffic with FTS.
Output of diagnose sys npu-session list/list-full does not mention policy route information.
Diagnose command should be available to show hit_count/last_used for policy route and NPU session on hyperscale VDOM.
Get PARSE SKIP ERROR=17 NPD ERR PBR ADDRESS console error log when system boots up.
The diagnose firewall ippool list command does not show the correct output for overload type IP pools.
NPD/LPMD process killed by out of memory killer after running mixed sessions and HA failover.
IPsec aggregate static route is not marked inactive if the IPsec aggregate is down.
IPsec static router gateway IP is set to the gateway of the tunnel interface when it is not specified.
NP dropping packet in the incoming direction for SoC4 models.
Logs are not seen for traffic passing through the firewall caused by numerous simultaneous configuration changes.
An error case occurs in WAD while handling the HTTP requests for an explicit proxy policy.
Slow GUI performance in large Fabric topology with over 50 downstream devices.
Security Rating report for Rogue AP Detection and FortiCare Support checks show incorrect results.
On the Security Fabric > Security Rating page, security rating test for FortiAnalyzer fails when connected to FortiAnalyzer Cloud.
Multiple DNS suffixes cannot be set for the SSL VPN portal.
User peer feature for one group to match to multiple user peers in the authentication rules is broken.
Traffic passing through an EMAC VLAN interface when the parent interface is in another VDOM is blocked if NP7 offloading is enabled.
observations.workaround: set the auto-asic-offload option to disable in the firewall policy.

observations.description: High memory usage occurs on FG-200F.
When setting the speed of 1G SFP ports on FG-180xF platforms to 1000full, the interface does not come up after rebooting.
Can't find xitem. Drop the response. error appears for DHCPOFFER packets in the DHCP relay debug.
NP7 platforms may encounter random kernel crash after reboot or factory reset.
Console may display mce: [Hardware Error] error message after fresh image burn or reboot.
Console keeps displaying bcm_nl.nr_request_drop ... after the FortiGate reboots because of the cfg-save revert setting under config system global. Affected platforms: FG-10xF and FG-20xF.
FG-20xF system halts if setting cfg-save to revert under config system global and after the cfg-revert-timeout occurs.
False alarm of the PSU2 occurs with only one installed.
The FortiGate is only offering the ssh-ed25519 algorithm for an SSH connection.
observations.workaround: factory reset the FortiGate, then restore the same configuration without making any changes to the configuration.

observations.description: FortiGate might enter conserve mode if disk logging is enabled and log-traffic all is set in a policy.
Kernel panic occurs due to null pointer dereference.
When a user is logged in as a VDOM administrator with restricted access and tries to upload a certificate (System > Certificates), the Create button on the Create Certificate pane is grayed out.
The kernel 4.19 cannot concurrently reassemble IPv4 fragments for a source IP with more than 64 destination IP addresses.

The endpoint-control fctems entry 0 is added after upgrading from 6.4 to 7.0.8 when the FortiGate does not have EMS server, which means the endpoint-control fctems feature was not enabled previously. This leads to a FortiManager installation failure.
observations.workaround: upgrade from FortiOS 6.4.x to 7.0.7 and then 7.0.8. If you have already upgraded to FortiOS 7.0.8, reboot the FortiGate to automatically set endpoint-control fctems to 1. If autoupdate is disabled on FortiManager, use Retrieve Config to synchronize the fix to FortiManager.

observations.description: After upgrading to 7.0.8, replacemsg utm parameters are not taken over and revert to the default. Affected replacement messages under config system replacemsg utm: virus-html, virus-text, dlp-html, dlp-text, and appblk-html.
When upgrading multiple firmware versions in the GUI, the Follow upgrade path option does not respect the recommended upgrade path.
Block replacement page is not pushed automatically to replace the video content when using a video filter.

ZTNA TCP forwarding is not working when a real server is configured with an FQDN address type. An FQDN address type that can resolve public IPs is not recommended for ZTNA TCP forwarding on real servers because the defined internal DNS database zone is trying to override it at the same time. By doing so, the internal private address may not take effect after rebooting, and causes a ZTNA TCP forwarding failure due to the real server not being found.
